Usage: astryx manifest [options]

Print the full CLI capability manifest (use with --json)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  the manifest cannot be generated

Examples:
  # Full manifest
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 manifest --json
  # The same manifest, under data.manifest (type "help")
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/manifest
